name: An An Lieu
title: Couples+ Therapist / Counsellor
description: A therapist who works with couples+ navigating relationship challenges, life transitions, trauma, grief, and emotional expression. Special interest in communication, infidelity, intimacy, reconnecting (intimacy and sex), and identity. Welcomes people from LGBTQIA+ communities, diverse cultural backgrounds, and all relationship structures. Can provide sessions in Mandarin.
specialties: couples therapy, trauma, intimacy and sex, infidelity, identity, EFT, Gottman Method, IFS, somatic therapy, Mandarin

name: Azul Rosenstein
title: Couples+ Therapist / Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical psychologist offering couples+ sessions via Telehealth. Draws on schema therapy, the Gottman Method (incl. 'Treating Affairs and Trauma'), and compassion-focused therapy; EMDR Part 1 and 2 trained. Welcomes couples+ of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and relationship structures. Experience with depression, trauma, anxiety, neurodivergence and grief. Also provides sessions in Spanish.
specialties: couples therapy, schema therapy, Gottman Method, EMDR, trauma, self-esteem, social anxiety, Spanish

name: Danielle Gervasoni
title: Couples+ Therapist / Psychologist (clinical registrar)
description: Registered psychologist and clinical registrar working with couples+ on communication, infidelity, separation, trauma experiences, intimacy and conflict. 'I am an LGBTIQA+ ally and welcome people in all relationships and intersectionalities.' Trauma-informed approach; outside Luma Room also works with individual adults on relationships, intimacy and sexual wellbeing. Tue, Thu, Sat incl. after hours.
specialties: couples therapy, trauma-informed, intimacy, sexual wellbeing, Gottman, EFT, DBT, CBT

name: Dr Melanie Schuijers
title: Couples+ Therapist / Clinical Psychologist, Founder
description: Registered clinical psychologist and founder of Luma Room; member of the Society of Australian Sexologists. 'This is a LGBTQIA+ friendly space ... All relationship structures are also welcome.' Relational and attachment-based lens; experience including complex relational trauma group programs. Supports couples+ to explore intimacy more deeply and navigate non-monogamy. Currently unavailable (waitlist).
specialties: couples therapy, attachment, intimacy, non-monogamy, relational trauma, intensive couples therapy

name: Finn Nugent
title: Couples+ Therapist / Family Therapist / Social Worker
description: Masters-qualified Social Worker with post-graduate qualifications in Family and Relationship Therapy. 'I am an LGBTQIA+ ally and welcome people in all relationship structures.' Works with couples+ navigating sexual issues, betrayals, polyamory and non-monogamy; informed by trauma-work, Internal Family Systems, polyvagal theory. Individual work on identity, sexuality, depression and anxiety.
specialties: couples therapy, family therapy, sexual issues, polyamory, non-monogamy, IFS, trauma, sexuality, chosen family

name: Genevieve Papavasiliou
title: Couples+ Therapist / Psychologist (clinical registrar)
description: Registered psychologist and clinical registrar working with couples and relationship systems on conflict, betrayal and infidelity, intimacy and connection. Welcomes people from LGBTQIA+ communities, diverse cultural backgrounds, and all relationship structures. Integrates the Gottman Method with CBT, ACT, Schema Therapy and CAT.
specialties: couples therapy, Gottman Method, schema therapy, ACT, CBT, CAT, intimacy, infidelity

name: Leah Vincent
title: Couples+ Therapist / Counselling Psychologist
description: Counselling psychologist practising for 20 years. 'I've had significant experience working with trauma including family violence and sexual assault.' Graduate diploma thesis centred around sex and gender when coping with relationship stress; previously program manager at Star Health incl. sex worker programs; worked at CASA. Narrative therapy, ACT and CBT. Currently unavailable (waitlist); Wednesday evenings.
specialties: couples therapy, trauma, family violence, sexual assault, narrative therapy, ACT, CBT

name: Mykah DeRose
title: Couples+ Therapist / Clinical Psychotherapist / Counsellor
description: Psychotherapist bringing a relational, systemic, and integrative approach to connection, communication, sex, intimacy, and conflict. Collaborative and trauma-informed. Works with heterosexual and cisgender couples, LGBTQIA+ communities, and people in consensually non-monogamous and polyamorous relationships. Areas include LGBTQIA+ affirmative practice, addiction, identity & life transitions; neuro-affirming. Saturday daytime.
specialties: couples therapy, LGBTQIA+ affirmative practice, sex and intimacy, consensual non-monogamy, polyamory, trauma-informed, addiction, identity

name: Sarah Dowse
title: Couples+ Therapist / Sexologist / Counsellor
description: Qualified sexologist and sex and relationship counsellor (Master of Sexology). Helps people develop healthier relationships with themselves, their sexuality, and others; conversations around sex, intimacy, and relationships free from shame. Welcomes people from all backgrounds, identities, sexualities, and relationship structures. Supports desire discrepancies, sexual connection and pleasure.
specialties: sexology, sex therapy, sexuality, intimacy, desire discrepancy, couples therapy
